name: mujoco_inverted_pendulum_v5
description: Canonical MuJoCo cart-pendulum balance benchmark using Gymnasium InvertedPendulum-v5.
notes: InvertedPendulum-v5 is a MuJoCo cart-pendulum balance task with continuous cart force control.
This is a reliable prebuilt pendulum-like task with a small continuous action space.
The task starts near upright and rewards balance, so it is not a swing-up-from-hanging benchmark.
